content: La Yecu yila ten mor bikur waber la nikange wo Yecu kanko nom-nokeu.

La ci mwe bibei tomangeb ceu a docimen nabire mwenge biduware a timtiye worinubo kila, kati yilo ci kwenan cinenten.Con too nubo kila kila, wo nubo twirau doti kawo naci kem bwiciu.
La ci mwe bibei tomangeb ceu a docimen nabire mwenge biduware a timtiye worinubo kila, kati yilo ci kwenan cinenten.
